triangles += index.size / 3 } return polygons to triangles } val grouped = count(Coplanarity.DEFAULT) val onePlane = count(Coplanarity.SINGLE_PLANE) markdown("what happened", listOf( "subpaths in this one FLine: 6 — three outer rings, three holes", "per-plane grouping: ${grouped.first} filled polygons, ${grouped.second} triangles", "one plane for everything, the old behaviour: ${onePlane.first} polygon, " + "${onePlane.second} triangles — two faces gone", "", "Orbit the view: all three faces are solid, each with its own square hole, and none of them is " + "inside out.
